title: Czech public broadcasters hold historic strike following government vote to abolish license fees
lede: Thousand of Czechs joined public TV and radio workers in their walkout over the Czech government's moves to bring public broadcasting under its political control.

title: Brazil’s fossil fuel roadmap sketches out first global timetable
lede: The COP30 presidency’s voluntary timetable asks countries to plan first, then build up clean energy - only turning to oil and gas supplies from 2031 The post Brazil’s fossil fuel roadmap sketches out first global timetable appeared first on Climate Home News .
